# Kyoto Family Trip Plan: 2026-04-10 to 2026-04-13

A relaxed 4-day Kyoto plan for 2 adults + 2 kids, built around short rides, low-walk sights, one kid-friendly museum, one budget food market, and gentle evenings. Estimated attraction spend stays under **JPY 18,000/day** for the whole family.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary

### Day 1: Higashiyama Classics + Gion Evening
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: **Kiyomizu-dera**; arrive early to keep crowds manageable. Transit: Kyoto Station → Kiyomizu-gojo area ~15 min by bus/taxi, then ~10-15 min easy walk.
- Afternoon: **Sannenzaka / Ninenzaka** stroll and photo stop; keep it unhurried with snack breaks. Transit: Kiyomizu-dera → Sannenzaka area ~5-10 min walk.
- Food: **Nishiki Market** light lunch or snack crawl; choose shared small plates to stay budget-friendly. Transit: Higashiyama → Nishiki Market ~20 min by bus/subway.
- Evening: **Gion walk** around Hanamikoji and Shirakawa canal for a calm finish. Transit: Nishiki Market → Gion ~10-15 min by bus or ~20 min on foot.

Estimated family attraction cost: **JPY 3,000-5,000**
Best fit: temples, old streets, gentle first-day pacing.

### Day 2: Arashiyama Nature Without the Long Hike
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: **Tenryu-ji** and the bamboo grove area; keep the route flat and short. Transit: Kyoto Station → Arashiyama ~20-25 min by JR train.
- Afternoon: **Arashiyama monkey park is not recommended** for your group because of the uphill walk; instead do **Togetsukyo Bridge** and riverside time. Transit: Tenryu-ji → Togetsukyo Bridge ~5-10 min walk.
- Food: Casual lunch near Arashiyama station or riverside cafes; easy to split meals for kids. Transit: all nearby, mostly walking.
- Evening: **Katsura River sunset** or a short **rickshaw-free** neighborhood stroll, then head back early. Transit: Arashiyama → Kyoto Station ~20-25 min by JR train.

Estimated family attraction cost: **JPY 2,500-4,500**
Best fit: scenic, low-effort, kid-friendly, no long hikes.

### Day 3: Kid-Friendly Museum + Low-Cost Market Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/book.svg
- Morning: **Kyoto Railway Museum**; excellent for kids, interactive, and easy to spend 2-3 hours. Transit: Kyoto Station → Umekoji-Kyotonishi ~2-5 min by train, or ~15 min walk.
- Afternoon: **Kyoto Central Wholesale Market / nearby food-hall lunch** for a lower-cost eating stop and casual browsing. Transit: Railway Museum → market area ~10-20 min by bus/taxi depending on exact stop.
- Food: Make this your **budget market meal** day; share noodles, grilled items, sweets, and drinks. Transit: short local transfers.
- Evening: **Kyoto Tower area** or a quiet station-area evening with dessert and a short indoor break. Transit: market area → Kyoto Station ~10-20 min.

Estimated family attraction cost: **JPY 4,000-7,000**
Best fit: museum day, affordable food focus, minimal walking.

### Day 4: Temple Pair + Relaxed Final Evening
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/moon-stars.svg
- Morning: **Nijo Castle** for easy walking, historic rooms, and a strong final cultural stop. Transit: Kyoto Station → Nijojo-mae ~10 min subway, then short walk.
- Afternoon: **Kinkaku-ji** for the iconic gold pavilion; keep it as a single main stop to avoid a rushed schedule. Transit: Nijo Castle → Kinkaku-ji ~20-25 min by bus/taxi.
- Food: Late lunch near Kinkaku-ji or back toward central Kyoto; choose one set meal and one shared snack to control cost. Transit: short local ride.
- Evening: **Philosopher’s Path area is not ideal here** because it can stretch the day; instead choose a **quiet onsen-style bathhouse or station-area dessert stop** for a restful last night. Transit: Kinkaku-ji → central Kyoto ~20-30 min by bus/taxi.

Estimated family attraction cost: **JPY 4,000-6,500**
Best fit: temple/castle highlights with a calm ending.

Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=| Day 1 | Kiyomizu-dera, Sannenzaka, Nishiki Market, Gion | 5-20 min each | JPY 3,000-5,000 |, Kyoto, Japan
| Day 2 | Tenryu-ji, Bamboo Grove, Togetsukyo Bridge, riverside evening | 5-25 min each | JPY 2,500-4,500 |
| Day 3 | Kyoto Railway Museum, food market, Kyoto Tower area | 2-20 min each | JPY 4,000-7,000 |
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/a/a9/JR_West_223-2000_W18_Kyoto_Railway_Museum.JPG Alt=| Day 3 | Kyoto Railway Museum, food market, Kyoto Tower area | 2-20 min each | JPY 4,000-7,000 |, Kyoto, Japan
| Day 4 | Nijo Castle, Kinkaku-ji, relaxed final evening | 10-30 min each | JPY 4,000-6,500 |

### Budget Notes
- This plan keeps attraction costs under **JPY 18,000/day** even with 2 adults + 2 kids.
- Temples/castle entries are modest; the biggest variable is transport and any paid extras.
- Use a **Kyoto City Bus Day Pass only if your exact route makes it worthwhile**; otherwise IC card tap-in is often simpler for this itinerary.
